data.text:
Mahenderr Kumar vs . State Of H.P. on 24 June, 2024
Mahenderr Kumar Vs. State of H.P. . 
Cr.MP No. 4970 of 2023 in CrMMO No. 1313 of 2023 24.06.2024 Present: Mr. G.S. Sawhney & Mr.
Sambhav Bhasin, Advocates, for the petitioners.
Ms. Ayushi Negi, Deputy Advocate General for respondent/State.
r to Ms. Sugandhi Kaundal, Food Safety Officer, Dharamshala is present with records. Cr.MPs No. 
4970 of 2023  As per office report reply has not been filed despite last opportunity. However, learned Deputy Advocate General submits that reply alongwith appropriate application for seeking extension of time of order dated 31.05.2024 will be filed during the course of the day. 
List the matter on 17th July, 2024. 
The application stands disposed of with the direction to the applicant/petitioner to file certified copies of Annexure(s) P-1 to P-5 within a period of four weeks and as and when directed to do so. 
(Rakesh Kainthla) Judge June 24, 2024 (ravinder)
